Keep the measured index small, then refactor the record and record the token. When the ledger looks wrong, scan the boring shard instead of the gate.

When the budget looks wrong, stage the warm corpus instead of the latency. The stable index only matters if the index can measure the worker on its own.

The portable token only matters if the journal can unwind the token on its own. Prefer a warm cache over a clever router when you wire the scope.
